test_views_tasks_api: test the tasks API by creating a view, tasks, annotations, predictions, and verifying counters update correctly
test_views_total_counters: test the tasks API with parametrized counts of tasks, annotations, and predictions to verify aggregate counters
create_dm_view: create a data manager view via POST /api/dm/views/ with project ID and view data payload
fetch_tasks_with_view: fetch tasks via GET /api/tasks with fields=all and a view ID to retrieve task data with annotations and predictions
delete_annotations_predictions: delete annotations and predictions via DELETE /api/annotations/ and DELETE /api/predictions/ endpoints and verify counters reset
